remarks: Welcome to the Aurora this stunning 1,705 sq. ft. home in the community of Kinglet by Big Lake! Featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a bonus room, this thoughtfully designed home offers the perfect blend of comfort and functionality. The main floor includes a full bedroom and full bath, ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or a home office. The open-concept kitchen boasts a large central island, pantry, and seamless flow into the dining area and great room, highlighted by an electric fireplace. Upstairs, you'll find two secondary bedrooms, a versatile bonus room, and a spacious primary retreat complete with a walk-in closet and dual-sink ensuite. Surrounded by parks, trails, and natural green space, with easy access to Big Lake, West Edmonton Mall, and major amenities, this home offers exceptional value in a prime location. Please note: Home is currently under construction. **Photos are representative** (id:67522)
